integration_issues.issue: captureSessionIdFromUrl() is defined in /app/frontend/src/google-auth.ts:65 and imported into /app/frontend/src/session.tsx:3 but is NEVER CALLED anywhere. On web, after returning from https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=... with session_id in the URL hash/query, nothing exchanges it for a JWT — user is silently signed out. Fix: call captureSessionIdFromUrl() inside SessionProvider's mount useEffect (before or after refresh()) and, on success, setUser(result.user). Reference: /app/frontend/src/session.tsx:43-48 and /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx (only calls SplashScreen).

action_items: HIGH: Wire captureSessionIdFromUrl() into SessionProvider mount so the web-side round-trip actually completes. Currently the entire web Google flow is broken end-to-end even though the button correctly navigates outbound (the return leg is missing). Suggested patch in /app/frontend/src/session.tsx useEffect: `const captured = await captureSessionIdFromUrl(); if (captured) { setUser(captured.user); } else { await refresh(); }` (order matters — capture first, then fall back to stored token refresh).

MEDIUM: SessionCtx type in /app/frontend/src/session.tsx:15-23 is missing signInWithGoogle in the type definition but the Provider does include it in the value at line 76. TS will flag this in strict mode; add `signInWithGoogle: () => Promise<{ is_new_user: boolean; needs_pro_completion: boolean } | null>` to the Ctx type.

LOW/optional: /api/auth/google could return 400 for empty-string session_id at the pydantic layer (via Field(min_length=1)) instead of relying on the upstream 401. Currently empty string produces a 401 from Emergent — functional but a shade less clear.

rca_of_issue: Missing invocation of captureSessionIdFromUrl() means the entire web Google Sign-In flow silently no-ops on the return leg: user taps 'Continue with Google' -> full-page redirect to auth.emergentagent.com -> Google auth completes -> Emergent redirects back to preview URL with #session_id=... -> the app cold-starts, SessionProvider useEffect only calls refresh() (which reads localStorage token -> none) -> user lands on /welcome again with the session_id still hanging in the URL fragment (until they reload and it's cleared). Reproduction: Currently un-reproducible end-to-end without a real Google login, but code path inspection confirms. Mitigation: add `const captured = await captureSessionIdFromUrl(); if (captured) setUser(captured.user);` to /app/frontend/src/session.tsx SessionProvider useEffect BEFORE calling refresh(). This is a single-line fix. Mobile flow (openAuthSessionAsync) works because it inline-exchanges before returning to signInWithGoogle.
